potential_conflicts.detail: 71 handlers are registered but BotFather exposes 47; missing: /v2, /symbols, /equity, /timeline, /status, /diagnostics, /posttrade, /calibration, /experiments, /learn, /filters, /blocked, /regime, /history, /report, /research_rank, /features, /strategies, /promotions, /top, /researchlab_on, /researchlab_off, /researchlab_dry_on, /researchlab_dry_off
No catch-all MessageHandler for unknown slash commands; users receive no response.
Every /start writes bot_config.json; the latest caller becomes the notification destination and the basis for owner checks.
Research Lab authorization compares effective_user.id with a stored chat_id; private chats happen to match, group chats do not.
/backfill and report synchronization commands are not owner-only and can write derived artifacts.
Dashboard callback synchronizes reports before formatting; /dashboard does not. They can show different freshness and have different side effects.
All replies are sliced at 3900 characters; the large dashboard is also sliced at 4096 internally. No pagination or continuation buttons.
blocked:{blocker} and regime:view are handled but no active keyboard emits them.
One CallbackQueryHandler has no pattern and catches every callback; unknown data silently opens help.
Russian and English labels, UTC/MSK/system-local timestamps, and numeric precision vary by formatter.
Signal duplicate detection hashes the full formatted text, which includes datetime.now(); identical setups in a later minute are not duplicates.
No photo, chart, animation, or document sending path exists.
All messages are plain text; typography relies on emoji, blank lines, and Unicode separators.
Formatting is split across legacy, v5, dashboard, news, live, research, consensus, adaptive, and Research Lab modules with overlapping names.
The Developer menu and most operational/research commands are accessible to every user; only four Research Lab overrides are guarded.
